tools.description: Publish a self-contained HTML document. Returns a public URL that renders it at your configured domain, /<id>. Provide a title and a short description for the artifact index.

category.description: Optional category to group the artifact within its org (e.g. 'Dashboards'). Blank = Uncategorized.

description.description: One-line description shown next to the link on the index.

html.description: Full self-contained HTML document to host.

org.description: Target org (admin keys only; org keys are locked to their own org).

title.description: Short title shown on the artifact index.

tools.name: publish_artifact

tools.description: Publish a multi-file artifact (e.g. several HTML pages that link to each other and a shared stylesheet). Provide files as a map of relative-path -> file contents; relative links between files resolve. Returns a public URL. Use this instead of publish_artifact when the HTML references other files like _shared.css or additional pages.

category.description: Optional category to group the artifact within its org. Blank = Uncategorized.

description.description: One-line description shown on the index.

entry.description: The HTML file to open first. Defaults to index.html, or the first .html file.

files.description: Map of relative path to file contents, e.g. {"index.html":"...","_shared.css":"..."}. Paths are relative; no leading slash or '..'.

title.description: Short title shown on the artifact index.

tools.name: publish_bundle

tools.description: List artifacts available to this API key: organization-wide for reader/collaborator keys, own-only for author keys, with URLs and uploader labels.
tools.name: list_artifacts

tools.description: Delete one of your artifacts by id.
tools.name: delete_artifact

tools.description: Replace an existing artifact's content and/or metadata in place, keeping the SAME id and URL so existing links keep working. Pass `html` for a single-file artifact or `files` for a bundle — the artifact type cannot change. Omitted title/description are preserved. Each effective change increments the artifact's revision.

category.description: New category (omit to keep current; empty string moves it to Uncategorized).

description.description: New description (omit to keep current; empty string clears it).

entry.description: Entry file for a bundle (defaults to the current entry, then index.html).

expected_revision.description: Optional current revision; the update is rejected if the artifact has changed.

files.description: New complete bundle snapshot (relative path -> content) for a bundle artifact; omitted files are removed.

html.description: New HTML for a single-file artifact.

title.description: New title (omit to keep the current one).

tools.name: update_artifact

tools.description: Unlist or relist one of your artifacts. Hidden artifacts remain accessible by direct URL to organization members; this is not access control.

hidden.description: True unlists it from the gallery; false relists it.

tools.name: set_visibility

tools.description: List the categories registered for your organization (used to group artifacts in the gallery). Admin keys may pass an org.

org.description: Org to list (admin keys only; defaults to your org).

tools.name: list_categories

tools.description: Move one of your artifacts into a category (empty string = Uncategorized). Also adds the category to your org's list so it appears in the picker. Does NOT create a new revision.

category.description: Target category; empty string moves it to Uncategorized.

tools.name: set_category

tools.description: Add a category to your organization's category list. Admin keys may pass an org.

org.description: Org (admin keys only; defaults to your org).

tools.name: create_category

tools.description: Remove a category from your organization's category list. Artifacts already tagged with it keep their tag. Admin keys may pass an org.

org.description: Org (admin keys only; defaults to your org).

tools.name: delete_category

tools.description: List the version history of one of your artifacts — each retained revision's number, title, size, and timestamp. Use with restore_artifact to roll back.
tools.name: list_revisions

tools.description: Create an unlisted public, read-only share link for one of your artifacts. It serves the live artifact until it expires or is revoked.
tools.name: create_share

tools.description: List active public share links for one of your artifacts.
tools.name: list_shares

tools.description: Revoke an active public share link you own. Revocation takes effect immediately.

token.description: Share token returned by create_share or list_shares.

tools.name: revoke_share

tools.description: Get named audience-view analytics for one of your artifacts: total views, unique viewers, last viewed time, and each viewer's count and timestamps.
tools.name: artifact_stats

tools.description: Restore a past revision of your artifact by number. Its content is re-published as a NEW revision at the same id/URL, so nothing is lost and the restore is itself undoable. Get revision numbers from list_revisions.
tools.name: restore_artifact

tools.description: List viewer feedback left on your artifacts. Pass an artifact id to scope to one; omit to list across all of your artifacts.

id.description: Optional artifact id to scope the feedback to.

tools.name: list_feedback

tools.description: Mark a piece of viewer feedback as resolved once you've addressed it.
tools.name: resolve_feedback

tools.description: Reopen previously resolved viewer feedback when more work is needed.
tools.name: reopen_feedback

tools.description: Read an artifact or retained revision with byte-bounded UTF-8 paging. A bundle without path returns its file listing; pass path to read one bundle file.

limit.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes to return; defaults to 65536.

path.description: Bundle file path. Omit to list bundle files.

revision.description: Optional retained revision number; defaults to the current revision.

tools.name: read_artifact

tools.description: Apply an atomic batch of UTF-8 byte-safe partial edits to an artifact. Find edits must match exactly once; range offsets refer to the pre-edit content.

edits.description: Atomic edits, each using either find/replace or offset/length/replace.

find.description: Exact UTF-8 text to replace; must occur exactly once.

length.description: UTF-8 byte length in the pre-edit content.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset in the pre-edit content.

expected_revision.description: Required current revision; stale patches are rejected.

path.description: Bundle file path. Required for bundle artifacts; omit for single-file artifacts.

tools.name: patch_artifact
